Bug_Title: Invalid "Date" values should not be used
Bug_Explanation: This code demonstrates the bug where an invalid date value is used. In the Date and Calendar objects, the month value starts at 0 and goes up to 11, but the setMonth() method is called with a value of 12. This is a bug because the Date or Calendar object will roll to the next year instead of throwing an error or exception. The same bug is present in showBug2() and showBug3() where Calendar objects are created with invalid month values.
Trigger_Explanation: This JUnit test case triggers the bug by asserting the year of the Date and Calendar objects after the bug is triggered. The assertion fails if the year is not incremented to the next year due to the bug.
